messages.text: what is the difference between the two interactive globes?

Both are 12" interactive globes with a wireless pointer pen that quizzes kids on facts, cap····, and geography — so they're very similar in format and price ($235 each). The main difference I can confirm from our listings is the model line: the **12" Interactive Talking World Globe with Wireless Intelli-Pen** has a raised-relief educational map, while the **Replogle Intelliglobe II** is our interactive desk globe with the same wireless pen system. I don't have more granular spec differences (like exact fact content) to compare beyond that, so if you want the fine details, the product pages themselves spell those out.

For a kids' pick, I'd lean toward the Interactive Talking World Globe — the raised relief lets them feel mountain ranges while they explore, which is a nice hands-on touch for younger learners. Is this globe for a particular age, or more for the whole family to use together?
